outlook.statement: Despite the challenges, the core strength of our business remains firmly intact. We are approaching this phase with clarity and determination, and we remain confident that the groundwork being laid today will translate into meaningful, sustainable growth in the years ahead.

The business environment is expected to improve gradually as inflation stabilises and policy rates ease. The Company remains committed to navigating this period of uncertainty through focused operational strategies, continued product innovation, and disciplined cost management. Efforts will continue toward realigning the business with prevailing market realities, identifying new growth opportunities, and enhancing value for all stakeholders. Near-term headwinds — including rising input costs, liquidity constraints, and competitive pressure — may continue to weigh on performance.

risks: Proposed investor(s) unable to infuse requisite funds towards applicable Government/ROC fee (estimated at approximately Rs. 35,00,000/-), causing resolutions to lapse for want of execution within timelines prescribed under the Companies Act, 2013.

The Company is exposed to risks relating to operations, credit, collateral, and liquidity. External factors such as shifts in the broader economy or changes in regulation may continue to present challenges, warranting ongoing monitoring and adaptability.
